doc: Detection duties of the reproducibility-tail plant. Each is a producer (the only polling), a signal with max_age, and a resolver role. Exit codes: 0 GREEN, 2 RED, anything else a failed observation that ages to UNKNOWN. For the two queue duties RED means work is owed: a low queue wakes scout, an unclaimed entry wakes rerun.

duties.name: dispatch
duties.covers: a wake left open (started/unknown) longer than 30 minutes

duties.name: queue-low
duties.covers: fewer than five open entries in queue/: the scout is owed a wake to register more pre-registered claims; while it stays RED the scout is offered the work again every 15 minutes (signal.reoffer), because a wake is otherwise owed only on a change of state and the queue can fall below five between two samples without ever reading GREEN

duties.name: queue-owed
duties.covers: an entry in queue/ with no live claim and no result: rerun is owed a wake; a claim older than six hours without a result counts as unclaimed again

duties.name: push-lag
duties.covers: local main reaches GitHub within a quarter hour (checks/push-lag.py): RED when the oldest unpushed commit is older, or main has diverged; UNKNOWN when the remote cannot be read. The post-commit hook (tools/post-commit-push.sh) pushes after a 30 s settle; the 17-commit backlog of 2026-11-26 had no hook

duties.name: gates
duties.covers: every report obeys the reproduction gates (docs/method.md, checks/gates.py): result.json present, claim unchanged since the run, verdict equal to the verdict computed from the recorded values, a logged original attempt before any patched or reimplemented basis, fidelity and replay passed, not-reproduced double-confirmed with a cause. RED lists each violation and wakes rerun to repair the report; UNKNOWN when a record cannot be read

duties.name: funnel
duties.covers: the candidate funnel is complete, ordered and evidenced (checks/funnel.py): every candidate is a line of queue/funnel.jsonl drawn from a named frame in the seeded order with none skipped, rejections carry a reason from the fixed list, unreachable cites two tried fallbacks and evidence, and the legacy unstructured queue/rejected.md has been migrated. RED lists each violation and wakes scout; UNKNOWN when a record cannot be read

duties.name: replay-due
duties.covers: gate G5: every reproduced result has a clean replay (tools/replay.py: scratch wiped, recipe.sh from nothing, VALUE lines compared with the record) newer than 7 days that agreed; RED lists results never replayed clean, replayed longer ago than that, or whose newest clean replay CHANGED; UNKNOWN when a record cannot be read. Read-only: rerun runs the replay

duties.name: scoreboard-fresh
duties.covers: ledger.md equals the text tools/build_ledger.py generates from reports/*/result.json; RED when it was edited by hand or a result changed without rebuilding it

duties.name: disk-floor
duties.covers: the spare drive under 60 GiB free, or this plant's scratch tree over 20 GiB: rerun takes no new entry and only cleans scratch
